subjectTypes: six real images from one place or event
firstVisualFocus: slanted tall torn landmark photograph with conspicuous paper edge, then the foreground face
spatialSkeleton: 3:4 six-cell photo grid; diagonal tower-like paper strip crosses cells; wide evidence paper at left-middle; large person paper at right; one serif place word at lower-left
imageTextRelationship: photographs prove a place or event; the one-word title identifies it after the image hook
optional: small real accent already inside source photos
forbidden: person or hero object too small
active before test and user acceptance

variableContract.person: replace identity while keeping the right foreground paper silhouette, clear face and comparable visible area
variableContract.text: replace exact short word while preserving lower-left single-line Roman serif role, box and weight; rewrite long text
variableContract.product: replace original landmark with a real recognizable hero object and secondary evidence while retaining scale, position, perspective and paper overlap
variableContract.palette: choose colors from current material; preserve low-to-medium saturation documentary base, bright paper/title and deep right visual weight

invariantContract.layout: 2x3 grid at x50/y32/y64; hero strip roughly x34-73/y0-67; secondary strip x0-40/y37-67; person x55-92/y40-100; title x13-45/y72-85
invariantContract.contentArea: grid visible about 55-65%; person about 25-32%; main paper width 35-45% and vertical span 60-70%; paper band 1.5-3% of width
specialEffects: photographic grain and soft documentary tone

assetTransformation.when: individual grid crops miss important facts
hero and person need the torn collage hierarchy
assetTransformation.action: separate hero-with-context and person paper layers, preserving identity and geometry
collect or capture real assets before production
